title_ar: سماحة الشيخ يحاضر في جامعة مولاي إسماعيل حول( العلوم الشرعية والمجتمع )
title_en: His Eminence the Sheikh Lectures at Moulay Ismail University on "The Sharia Sciences and Society"
body_ar:
بمناسبة افتتاح العام الدراسي في كلية الآداب بجامعة مولاي إسماعيل بمكناس ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء محاضرة بالقاعة الكبرى بالكلية تحت عنوان : ( العلوم الشرعية والمجتمع ) وتميز الحضور بتنوع شمل رئيس المجلس العلمي بالمدينة وعميد الكلية ورئيس شعبة الدراسات الإسلامية وعدد كبير من الأساتذة والطلاب.

لمتابعة هذه المحاضرة أضغط هنا: http://dedewnet.com/index.php/adabiyat.html?view=media&id=1564

كما ألقى محاضرة أخرى هامة تحت عنوان: (أولويات الأمة للقيام بالشهادة)

لمتابعة هذه المحاضرة أضغط هنا:http://dedewnet.com/index.php/adabiyat.html?view=media&id=1560
body_en:
On the occasion of the opening of the academic year at the Faculty of Letters of Moulay Ismail University in Meknes, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, delivered a lecture in the faculty's main hall under the title: (The Sharia sciences and society). The attendance was notable for its variety, taking in the president of the city's scholarly council, the dean of the faculty, the head of the Islamic studies department, and a large number of teaching staff and students.

He also delivered another important lecture under the title: (The community's priorities for carrying out the bearing of witness).

flags.context: the title of the second lecture, given without any content
options: the community's priorities for carrying out the bearing of witness
the community's priorities in discharging its witness over mankind
the ummah's priorities in fulfilling the testimony
flags.note: الشهادة here is the community's bearing witness over mankind (Qur'an 2:143), not testimony in court and not the shahādah of the creed. The English has to choose one of the three senses and the Arabic gives no gloss; option 1 keeps it closest to the words without importing the Qur'anic reference the title only alludes to. Since the record gives the title and nothing else, a reviewer with the recording should confirm the intended sense before it is fixed.

options: the president of the city's scholarly council
the head of the local religious council (majlis ʿilmī)
the chairman of the Meknes ulema council
flags.note: The Moroccan majālis ʿilmiyyah are the official regional councils of religious scholars under the Ministry of Habous. 'Scholarly council' is literal and neutral; the other options explain the institution but insert a description the Arabic does not give.

translator_notes: A short announcement written by the site's news desk. It reports that two lectures were given and gives no content from either, so there is nothing in it that could be mistaken for a ruling.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the announcement was written; nor does the body supply a date for the lectures.

The two 'click here' lines are the site's navigation furniture, and the bare URLs they contain are part of that furniture. They are preserved in body_ar, recorded in source_download_link and embedded_media, and omitted from body_en. Removing them leaves body_en with two paragraphs where body_ar has four; that is deliberate.
The substance of both lectures exists only as audio at the two links recorded. This record is an announcement of them, not a text of either.
